from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from decimal import Decimal
import pypdfium2 as pdfium
import pdfplumber
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont
import json,re,csv,hashlib
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_corporate_loan_weighted_rate_source_qualification_v1")
proto=json.loads((OUT/"protocol.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
receipts=json.loads((OUT/"pdf_receipts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
summaries=json.loads((OUT/"全部16原报告全文与封面核对.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
summary_by={x["quarter"]:x for x in summaries}
assert all(x["cover_exact_requested_quarter"] for x in summaries)
assert not (OUT/"16季度企业贷款表3原值.csv").exists()
rows=[]; contracts=[]; tiles=[]
for source in receipts:
    q=source["quarter"]; year=int(q[:4]); month=3*int(q[-1])
    pages=json.loads((OUT/"extracted_pages"/(q+"_pages.json")).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    expected=f"{year}年{month}月"
    hits=[]
    for page in pages:
        compact=re.sub(r"\s+","",page["text"])
        header=re.search(r"表3"+re.escape(expected)+r"新发放贷款加权平均利率情况",compact)
        if not header: continue
        scope=compact[header.start():]
        scope=scope[:scope.find("表4")] if "表4" in scope else scope
        target=re.search(r"其中[：:]企业贷款加权平均利率(\d+\.\d{2})",scope)
        assert target is not None,(q,"企业贷款表3同名行缺失")
        rate=target.group(1); assert Decimal(rate).is_finite()
        hits.append({"pdf_page":page["pdf_page_1based"],"rate":rate,"table_text":scope,
                     "raw_target_row_context":scope[max(0,target.start()-45):target.end()+85]})
    assert len(hits)==1,(q,hits)
    hit=hits[0]
    row={"季度":q,"统计月":f"{year}-{month:02d}","原字段":"其中：企业贷款加权平均利率",
         "原表":"表3 "+expected+"新发放贷款加权平均利率情况","单位":"%",
         "企业贷款利率_百分数":hit["rate"],"PDF页_从1计":hit["pdf_page"],
         "页面显示公布时间":source["displayed_published_at"],
         "当时可知日末代理":source["displayed_published_at"][:10]+"T23:59:59+08:00",
         "PDF路径":source["path"],"PDF_SHA256":source["sha256"],"历史首版认证":"NOT_CERTIFIED"}
    rows.append(row)
    contract={**row,"full_table_text":hit["table_text"],"raw_target_row_context":hit["raw_target_row_context"],
              "cover_text":summary_by[q]["cover_text"],"pdf_metadata":summary_by[q]["metadata"],
              "source_pub_clock_boundary":"原正式页面显示时间的历史重建代理，非当年实际接收回执",
              "target_scope_boundary":"本季度表3同名企业子项；不自动与正文近似值、全年均值、普惠/科技/一般贷款等同"}
    contracts.append(contract)
    with pdfplumber.open(source["path"]) as pdf:
        p=pdf.pages[hit["pdf_page"]-1]
        headers=p.search(r"表\s*3",regex=True)
        assert len(headers)==1,(q,headers)
        top=max(0,headers[0]["top"]-12)
        bottoms=[x for x in p.search("数据来源",regex=False) if x["top"]>top]
        bottom=min((x["bottom"]+22 for x in bottoms),default=p.height)
        assert top<bottom<=p.height
    doc=pdfium.PdfDocument(source["path"])
    page=doc.get_page(hit["pdf_page"]-1)
    height=page.get_height()
    bitmap=page.render(scale=1.6,crop=(0,max(0,height-bottom),0,top))
    image=bitmap.to_pil()
    cropped=OUT/"rendered_source_pages"/(q+"_表3.png")
    image.save(cropped)
    tiles.append({"quarter":q,"path":str(cropped).replace("\\","/"),"rate":hit["rate"]})
    image.close();bitmap.close();page.close();doc.close()
with (OUT/"16季度企业贷款表3原值.csv").open("w",encoding="utf-8-sig",newline="") as handle:
    writer=csv.DictWriter(handle,fieldnames=list(rows[0]));writer.writeheader();writer.writerows(rows)
(OUT/"16季度企业贷款字段原文合同.json").write_text(json.dumps(contracts,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
(OUT/"表3取值规则与正文边界.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "saved_at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),
    "binding":"只读固定季度末月份表3中的同名企业贷款加权平均利率首个水平单元，单位%。",
    "why":"原表提供明确月份/单位/子项与精度，正文可能是约值/全年值/其他子类；不依据股票收益选数字。",
    "no_backfill_or_derived_old_values":True,"new_equity_labels":0,"new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0,
    "not_total_financing_cost":True,"object_currency_and_weight_scope_not_assumed_beyond_original_table":True
},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
font=ImageFont.truetype(r"C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc",22)
contact_paths=[]
for year in range(2022,2026):
    year_tiles=[x for x in tiles if x["quarter"].startswith(str(year))]
    loaded=[Image.open(x["path"]).convert("RGB") for x in year_tiles]
    width=max(x.width for x in loaded)
    row_height=max(x.height for x in loaded)+45
    canvas=Image.new("RGB",(2*width,2*row_height),(245,245,245))
    draw=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    for i,(im,meta) in enumerate(zip(loaded,year_tiles)):
        x=(i%2)*width;y=(i//2)*row_height
        draw.text((x+12,y+8),meta["quarter"]+" 原表3；企业子项 "+meta["rate"]+"%",font=font,fill=(20,20,20))
        canvas.paste(im,(x,y+40)); im.close()
    target=OUT/"rendered_source_pages"/(str(year)+"年四季度表3核对.png")
    canvas.save(target);canvas.close();contact_paths.append(str(target).replace("\\","/"))
(OUT/"四张原表目视核对路径.json").write_text(json.dumps(contact_paths,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
for row in rows: print(row["季度"],row["统计月"],row["企业贷款利率_百分数"],row["页面显示公布时间"])
print("16季度原表值已提取；四张原表拼页待目视核对，尚未准入模型。")
